correctness.rationale: Shellability (Kozlov/Jojić, arXiv:1109.4475v2 §§1–2) applies to the bidirected triangular book with universal hubs, giving one-degree free homology. Signed augmented Hopf trace is derived explicitly. The invariant rooted-forest orbit decomposition covers all permutation cycle lengths and all hub-arrow possibilities. A matrix-forest determinant gives the fixed-hub character and forced hub-arrow targets give the swap character. Standalone verifier checks 56 conjugacy classes for k=2..6 and independent mod-2 chain ranks for k=2..4; these are only cross-checks.
